mapper.insert: INSERT INTO login_lock (username, lock_time, unlock_time, fail_count, lock_reason, is_locked, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{username}, #{lockTime}, #{unlockTime}, #{failCount}, #{lockReason}, #{isLocked}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM login_lock WHERE username = #{username} AND is_locked = 1 AND unlock_time > NOW() LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE login_lock SET is_locked = 0, updated_at = NOW() WHERE username = #{username} AND is_locked = 1
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM login_lock WHERE is_locked = 1 AND unlock_time > NOW() ORDER BY lock_time DESC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM login_lock WHERE is_locked = 0 OR unlock_time <= NOW()
mapper.update: UPDATE login_lock SET fail_count = #{failCount}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE username = #{username}
mapper.select: SELECT fail_count FROM login_lock WHERE username = #{username} AND is_locked = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO login_lock (username, fail_count, is_locked, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{username}, #{failCount}, 0, NOW(), NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE fail_count = #{failCount}, updated_at = NOW()
